title: WebDavBlockStore does not use impl_ipfs_block_store_via_inner macro unlike S3/Azure/GCS
description: In post/webdav_store.rs, the IpfsBlockStore impl is written out manually (4 methods delegating to self.0) instead of using the impl_ipfs_block_store_via_inner! macro that S3BlockStore, AzureBlockStore, and GcsBlockStore all use. This is inconsistency without justification; if the macro ever changes, WebDav will diverge silently.
